note: 13 categories × 13 known achievements (169) + 169 hidden. Only some are live in this build; the rest show as 'unannounced'. Shame achievements stay hidden until first earned and pay a cosmetic once; everything else pays scrap. Fields: on = game event, n = times needed, eq/min = filters on the event, distinct = count different values of this field.
